title: Sources: the EU plans to mobilize up to €50B for its Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to make long-term, high-risk bets on European AI and quantum computing companies (Barbara Moens/Financial Times)
summary: Barbara Moens / Financial Times: Sources: the EU plans to mobilize up to €50B for its Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to make long-term, high-risk bets on European AI and quantum computing companies — Brussels plans to take stakes in AI and quantum computing companies to try to bolster Europe's technological independence
